hero.title: Ntọala
hero.subtitle: Ọdịdị, ọkwa, obodo na asụsụ, na ụzọ mkpirisi ezinụlọ.

familySection.guest: Banye iji hazie profaịlụ ezinụlọ gị, ụmụaka, na njikọ di/nwunye.
familySection.hint: Tinye ụmụaka ma jikọọ di/nwunye gị. Nne na nna ọ bụla na-echekwa data CareMate nke ya.

location.title: Ebe
location.guestHint: Banye iji hazie obodo na asụsụ gị. Ndị ọbịa na-eji nhọrọ mmalite.
location.hint: A na-eji ya maka ọdịnaya ahụike mpaghara na mmasị asụsụ.

legal.title: Iwu
legal.openFailed: Enweghị ike imepe njikọ. Lelee njikọ gị.

account.title: Akaụntụ
account.deleteHint: Na-ehichapụ akaụntụ CareMate gị na data ejikọtara kpamkpam. Enweghị ike ịweghachi ya.
account.deleteConfirmMessage: Profaịlụ gị, kaadị mberede, njikọ ezinụlọ, na ngwaọrụ ahụike ejikọtara ga-ehichapụ kpamkpam. A ga-akagbu ndenye aha na-arụ ọrụ ma ọ bụrụ na o kwe omume.
account.deleteSuccessMessage: Ehichapụrụ akaụntụ CareMate gị. Ị nwere ike ịmepụta nke ọhụrụ oge ọ bụla.
